# T5 Venue manager

Status: Draft for product-owner review (b10-design §7.2 item 1). Not delivered at any venue.

- Audience: Manager accounts and staff holding a manager grant
- Runs it: PO
- Length: 15 minutes in the shift ([walkthrough](README.md#walkthrough))
- Practical task: Decide one finding and one recheck.

## Covers

- To confirm and conflicting findings
- Self-confirmation, where the question allows it
- Rechecks
- Triage on the overview
- Menu photo review
- Assigning checks
- Manager uploads (owner decision 32)

## What the app says

- Ask for another photo needs a reason (what the next photo should show).
- After a network failure, trying again never decides twice.
- It waits in To confirm until someone else decides.
